title: Highland property-site config
description: The single property-owned input to the template kit and onboarding skill. Everything property-specific lives here; the kit code never carries property literals. Secrets appear as env-var NAMES only — never values.

configVersion.description: Version of this schema the config was written against, e.g. "1".

kitVersion.description: Pinned template-kit release tag this site is generated from (e.g. kit-v1.0.0). Sites never float on the kit.

name.description: Full marketing name, e.g. "Woods Crossing Apartments".

shortName.description: Short name used in copy, e.g. "Woods Crossing".

canonicalOrigin.description: The ONE canonical origin, e.g. https://www.woodscrossingslc.com. Everything else 301s here in one hop.

domains.description: All owned domains/hosts (apex, www, legacy domains) that must 301 to canonicalOrigin.

legacyOrigins.description: Origins of legacy sites being replaced (discovery targets).

phone.description: E.164 or display form; keep ONE authoritative form.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string for the property's local time — used by the showing scheduler and slot normaliser. Examples: "America/Chicago", "America/Denver", "America/New_York".

designDirection.description: The APPROVED design direction (human gate G3). Name + one-sentence concept; never inferred.

tokens.description: Design tokens: colors, font families, radii. Keys are consumed by the kit's Tailwind theme.

logoAssets.description: Paths (in the new project) to approved logo/brand asset files.

reuseRightsConfirmed.description: Human gate G2: owner confirmed rights to reuse legacy photos/copy. Never assume.

facts.description: Verified leasing facts (pet policy, deposits, fees, unit mix). Every value must exist in the uncertainty register as CONFIRMED before build uses it.

database.description: AppFolio database host prefix, e.g. "highlandrealestatepartners" (NOT the marketing brand — verify: wrong host looks like an egress block).

propertyName.description: EXACT property name for filters[property_list] — verify via the unit_directory report first (human gate G7).

tourUnitName.description: Name of the hidden real unit used for general tour bookings (leasing team creates it; human gate G7).

parityMapPath.description: Path to the human-APPROVED parity map CSV (gate G4). The build imports redirects from it; unreviewed rows fail the build.

utmStorageKey.description: sessionStorage key for visit-source capture, e.g. "woodscrossing_utm_params".

alertInbox.description: Technical/watchdog alerts ONLY — never mix with leasing.

secrets.description: Env-var NAMES only. Values are set in Replit Secrets by the operator (gate G5).

dnsProvider.description: Registrar/DNS host — traps differ (Squarespace: delete Domain Connect presets before forwarding saves).

indexNowKey.description: true once an IndexNow key file is generated and served.

crawlMode.description: live = direct crawl; archive = Wayback CDX fallback (bot-walled sites); offline = pre-scraped inventory.
